params.source:
# HALO v2 — production model of the ring-wing toroidal-rotor tail-sitter
# World frame: +Z up in hover; in cruise the craft flies nose-first along +Z. Units mm.
# Every part is a component (bill_of_materials), every repeated part an instance of one component.
design halo_v2 units=mm

# --- driving parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------
param ringLe = 215          # radius of the ring-wing leading edge
param ringChord = 170       # ring-wing (duct) chord
param ringTe = 10           # height of the ring trailing edge
param skin = 0.3            # ring skin: 3 plies of 0.1 mm thin-ply CFRP (±45 / 0)
param rib = 1               # four internal ring ribs at the vane stations
param tipGap = 3            # rotor tip clearance to the duct throat
param bellR = 32            # hub-motor bell outer radius (the loops root on it)
param bellH = 22            # hub-motor bell height
param loopChord = 24        # toroidal blade section chord (NACA 0012)
param loopTilt = 22         # loop-plane tilt, deg (≈ blade arm pitch)
param zUpper = 148          # upper rotor plane
param zLower = 60           # lower rotor plane
param podR = 30             # pod outer radius
param strutChord = 30       # fixed part of each exit vane (NACA 0012)
param flapChord = 16        # hinged flap (NACA 0008), hinge 1 mm behind the strut
param flapDeg = 0           # flap deflection (control input)
param footZ = -32           # lowest point of the TPU feet (ground contact in hover attitude)
param cellZ = zLower+9      # battery layer 1 (2 x 2 21700 cells) sits between the two stators
param cellZ2 = 222          # battery layer 2, above the avionics: sets the CG (static margin)

param throatR = ringLe - 0.098*ringChord              # NACA 4412 upper surface (inward) peak ≈ 0.098 c
param loopTipR = throatR - tipGap
param loopRoot = bellR - 1.5                         # loop roots sink 1.5 mm into the bell
param loopR = (loopTipR - loopRoot)/2 - loopChord/2   # centreline radius of one blade loop
param loopC = (loopTipR + loopRoot)/2                    # radial position of a loop centre
param strutTop = ringTe + 12

# --- materials (datasheet densities; the loops and vanes are CFRP over a foam core) ----
create_material _ name=cfrp_thin_ply density=1.55 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#2b3038" metalness=0.2 roughness=0.35 finish=carbon_twill finishScale=12 clearcoat=1
create_material _ name=cfrp_foam_core density=0.45 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#c8553d" roughness=0.45
create_material _ name=al_7075_t6 density=2.81 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#b8bcc2" metalness=0.9 roughness=0.3 finish=brushed
create_material _ name=li_ion_21700 density=2.82 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#2f7d4f" roughness=0.5
create_material _ name=stator_cu_fe density=0.85 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#b06a3a" metalness=0.7 roughness=0.4
create_material _ name=fr4_pcba density=1.9 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#1f6b3a" roughness=0.6
create_material _ name=servo_eff density=4.0 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#2a2d33" roughness=0.6
create_material _ name=pc_optical density=1.2 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#3a6ea5" roughness=0.05
create_material _ name=cfrp_foam_vane density=0.45 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#3a3f47" roughness=0.45
create_material _ name=camera_module density=2.0 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#2a2d33" roughness=0.5
create_material _ name=tpu_95a density=1.21 densityUnit="g/cm^3" color="#e0a526" roughness=0.8

# --- ring wing: hollow thin-ply shell, camber facing the axis, 4 internal ribs ----------
draw_naca_airfoil sec naca="4412" chord=ringChord incidenceDeg=-90 position=[ringLe, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=50
offset_2d secIn id=sec distance=skin
revolve_profile ringOuter profileIds=[sec] axis="z" segments=128 rotation=[180deg, 0, 0] position=[0, 0, ringTe+ringChord] color="#1d2126"
revolve_profile ringCavity profileIds=[secIn] axis="z" segments=128 rotation=[180deg, 0, 0] position=[0, 0, ringTe+ringChord]
# one Ø2 mm pressure-equalisation vent per rib bay (outer skin, z 130): a hollow composite part must breathe
for i in 0..3 {
  add_cylinder vent{i} radius=1 height=24 position=[212*cos((2*i+1)*pi/4), 212*sin((2*i+1)*pi/4), 130] axis=[cos((2*i+1)*pi/4), sin((2*i+1)*pi/4), 0]
}
add_box teCloseout size=[2*ringLe+40, 2*ringLe+40, ringChord] position=[0, 0, ringTe+8+ringChord/2]   # cavity ends 8 mm before the TE: solid laminate close-out
boolean cavTrim op=intersect a=ringCavity b=teCloseout
boolean cav1 op=union a=cavTrim b=vent0
boolean cav2 op=union a=cav1 b=vent1
boolean cav3 op=union a=cav2 b=vent2
boolean cavVented op=union a=cav3 b=vent3
boolean ringShell op=subtract a=ringOuter b=cavVented
revolve_profile ribCore profileIds=[sec] axis="z" segments=128 rotation=[180deg, 0, 0] position=[0, 0, ringTe+ringChord]
add_box ribX size=[2*ringLe+20, rib, ringChord+10] position=[0, 0, ringTe+ringChord/2]
add_box ribY size=[rib, 2*ringLe+20, ringChord+10] position=[0, 0, ringTe+ringChord/2]
boolean ribCross op=union a=ribX b=ribY
boolean ribs op=intersect a=ribCore b=ribCross
boolean ring op=union a=ringShell b=ribs
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_thin_ply entityIds=[ring]
create_component cRing name="Ring wing (CFRP thin-ply shell + ribs)" componentId=c-ring entityIds=[ring]

# --- pod: 0.6 mm CFRP shell, nose ogive, tail cone (profile = outer up, inner down) -----
revolve_profile podShell axis="z" segments=96 color="#e8e6e1" profile=[[0,-8],[8,0],[16,12],[22,25],[26,38],[29.5,50],[30,60],[30,310],[28,322],[24,332],[17.5,340],[16.9,340],[23.4,331.5],[27.4,321.5],[29.4,310],[29.4,60],[28.9,50.5],[25.4,38.5],[21.4,25.6],[15.4,12.6],[7.4,0.8],[0,-7.2]]
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_thin_ply entityIds=[podShell]
create_component cPod name="Pod shell (CFRP, 0.6 mm)" componentId=c-pod entityIds=[podShell]
add_sphere dome radius=18 position=[0, 0, 334] color="#3a6ea5"
add_box domeCut size=[40, 40, 30] position=[0, 0, 319]
boolean domeCap op=subtract a=dome b=domeCut
assign_material _ materialName=pc_optical entityIds=[domeCap]
create_component cDome name="Sensor dome (PC, optical)" componentId=c-dome entityIds=[domeCap]
add_box cam size=[18, 18, 14] position=[0, 0, 326] color="#2a2d33"
assign_material _ materialName=camera_module entityIds=[cam]
create_component cCam name="Camera module + gimbal-less EIS board" componentId=c-cam entityIds=[cam]

# --- battery: 8 x 21700 (4S2P, 5 Ah cells, 144 Wh): one layer between the motors, one above the avionics
add_cylinder cell radius=10.55 height=70 position=[10.75, 10.75, cellZ] anchor=base-center color="#2f7d4f"
assign_material _ materialName=li_ion_21700 entityIds=[cell]
create_component cell0 name="Li-ion cell 21700 (5 Ah)" componentId=c-cell entityIds=[cell]
for i in 1..3 {
  insert_instance cell{i} componentId=c-cell position=[-21.5*mod(i,2), -21.5*floor(i/2), 0]
}
for i in 4..7 {
  insert_instance cell{i} componentId=c-cell position=[-21.5*mod(i-4,2), -21.5*floor((i-4)/2), cellZ2-cellZ]
}

# --- hub motors: stator inside the pod skin, bell outside carrying the loops -----------
add_cylinder stator radius=27 height=16 position=[0, 0, zUpper-8] anchor=base-center color="#b06a3a"
assign_material _ materialName=stator_cu_fe entityIds=[stator]
create_component stator0 name="Hub-motor stator (36N42P, Cu/Fe)" componentId=c-stator entityIds=[stator]
insert_instance stator1 componentId=c-stator position=[0, 0, zLower-zUpper]

# --- upper rotor: Al bell + three toroidal loops ---------------------------------------
revolve_profile bellA axis="z" segments=96 position=[0, 0, zUpper-bellH/2] color="#b8bcc2" profile=[[30.5,0],[32,0],[32,22],[30.5,22]]   # bell section: r 30.5-32 (= bellR), h 22 (= bellH)
assign_material _ materialName=al_7075_t6 entityIds=[bellA]
draw_naca_airfoil s1 naca="0012" chord=loopChord position=[loopR-loopChord/2, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=24
revolve_profile loopA0 profileIds=[s1] axis="z" segments=64 position=[loopC, 0, zUpper] rotation=[loopTilt*pi/180, 0, 0] color="#c8553d"
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_foam_core entityIds=[loopA0]
array_polar loopsA id=loopA0 count=3 center=[0, 0, 0]
create_component rotorUpper name="Upper rotor: bell + 3 toroidal loops" componentId=c-rotor-upper entityIds=[bellA, loopA0, loopsA[0], loopsA[1]]

# --- lower rotor: opposite hand, four loops (3 vs 4: co-prime interaction tones) -------
revolve_profile bellB axis="z" segments=96 position=[0, 0, zLower-bellH/2] color="#b8bcc2" profile=[[30.5,0],[32,0],[32,22],[30.5,22]]   # bell section: r 30.5-32 (= bellR), h 22 (= bellH)
assign_material _ materialName=al_7075_t6 entityIds=[bellB]
draw_naca_airfoil s2 naca="0012" chord=loopChord position=[loopR-loopChord/2, 0, 0] pointsPerSide=24
revolve_profile loopB0 profileIds=[s2] axis="z" segments=64 position=[loopC, 0, zLower] rotation=[-loopTilt*pi/180, 0, 0] color="#d98a3a"
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_foam_core entityIds=[loopB0]
array_polar loopsB id=loopB0 count=4 center=[0, 0, 0]
create_component rotorLower name="Lower rotor: bell + 4 toroidal loops" componentId=c-rotor-lower entityIds=[bellB, loopB0, loopsB[0], loopsB[1], loopsB[2]]

# --- avionics bay above the upper motor ---------------------------------------------------
add_box esc size=[36, 36, 5] position=[0, 0, 168] color="#1f6b3a"
assign_material _ materialName=fr4_pcba entityIds=[esc]
create_component cEsc name="Dual ESC, 2 x 40 A (FOC)" componentId=c-esc entityIds=[esc]
add_box fc size=[36, 36, 1.6] position=[0, 0, 180] color="#1f6b3a"
assign_material _ materialName=fr4_pcba entityIds=[fc]
create_component cFc name="Flight controller (H7, IMU x2, baro)" componentId=c-fc entityIds=[fc]
add_box gnss size=[25, 25, 6] position=[0, 0, 192] color="#2a5d8a"
assign_material _ materialName=fr4_pcba entityIds=[gnss]
create_component cGnss name="GNSS + telemetry radio" componentId=c-gnss entityIds=[gnss]

# --- exit vanes: fixed strut + hinged flap, x4 -----------------------------------------
draw_naca_airfoil vs naca="0012" chord=strutChord pointsPerSide=24
extrude_profile strut id=vs depth=ringLe axis=[1, 0, 0] color="#4a4f57"
move_entities _ ids=[strut] delta=[0, 0, strutTop]
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_foam_vane entityIds=[strut]
create_component strutI0 name="Vane strut (CFRP / foam)" componentId=c-strut entityIds=[strut]
for i in 1..3 {
  insert_instance strutI{i} componentId=c-strut rotation=[0, 0, i*pi/2]
}
draw_naca_airfoil vf naca="0008" chord=flapChord incidenceDeg=flapDeg pointsPerSide=20
extrude_profile flap id=vf depth=ringLe-40 axis=[1, 0, 0] color="#6b7380"
move_entities _ ids=[flap] delta=[20, 0, strutTop-strutChord-1]   # hinge line 1 mm behind the strut
assign_material _ materialName=cfrp_foam_vane entityIds=[flap]
create_component flapI0 name="Vane flap (CFRP / foam), hinged" componentId=c-flap entityIds=[flap]
for i in 1..3 {
  insert_instance flapI{i} componentId=c-flap rotation=[0, 0, i*pi/2]
}
add_box servo size=[8, 4, 18] position=[8.5, 8.5, 26] color="#2a2d33"
assign_material _ materialName=servo_eff entityIds=[servo]
create_component servoI0 name="Linear micro servo (flap actuator)" componentId=c-servo entityIds=[servo]
for i in 1..3 {
  insert_instance servoI{i} componentId=c-servo rotation=[0, 0, i*pi/2]
}

# --- TPU feet under the struts (the craft stands on them) ------------------------------
add_cylinder footLeg radius=5 height=strutTop-strutChord-footZ-5 position=[204, 0, footZ+5] anchor=base-center
add_sphere footBall radius=5 position=[204, 0, footZ+5]
boolean foot op=union a=footLeg b=footBall
assign_material _ materialName=tpu_95a entityIds=[foot]
create_component footI0 name="Landing foot (TPU 95A)" componentId=c-foot entityIds=[foot]
for i in 1..3 {
  insert_instance footI{i} componentId=c-foot rotation=[0, 0, i*pi/2]
}

# --- joints: how the parts are held (brackets, bearings and harness are not modelled) --
set_part_grounded _ ids=[cRing] grounded=true      # airframe datum
for i in 0..3 {
  allow_interference _ a=strutI{i} b=cRing kind=weld reason="vane strut bonded through the ring rib"
  allow_interference _ a=strutI{i} b=cPod kind=weld reason="strut root bonded into the pod tail cone"
  allow_interference _ a=footI{i} b=strutI{i} kind=weld reason="TPU foot bonded on the strut"
  allow_interference _ a=flapI{i} b=strutI{i} kind=weld reason="flap hinge (2 x 1 mm CFRP pins, not modelled)"
  allow_interference _ a=servoI{i} b=cPod kind=weld reason="servo screwed to the tail-cone bulkhead"
}
for i in 0..2 {
  allow_interference _ a=strutI{i} b=strutI{i+1} kind=weld reason="cruciform strut root"
}
allow_interference _ a=strutI3 b=strutI0 kind=weld reason="cruciform strut root"
allow_interference _ a=strutI0 b=strutI2 kind=overlap_by_design reason="opposite struts share the cross joint"
allow_interference _ a=strutI1 b=strutI3 kind=overlap_by_design reason="opposite struts share the cross joint"
for i in 0..7 {
  allow_interference _ a=cell{i} b=cPod kind=weld reason="cell held in the moulded battery cradle"
}
allow_interference _ a=stator0 b=cPod kind=weld reason="stator bonded on the pod spine"
allow_interference _ a=stator1 b=cPod kind=weld reason="stator bonded on the pod spine"
allow_interference _ a=rotorUpper b=cPod kind=press_fit reason="bell on a thin-section bearing pair (not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=rotorLower b=cPod kind=press_fit reason="bell on a thin-section bearing pair (not modelled)"
allow_interference _ a=cEsc b=cPod kind=weld reason="avionics tray"
allow_interference _ a=cFc b=cPod kind=weld reason="avionics tray, soft-mounted"
allow_interference _ a=cGnss b=cPod kind=weld reason="avionics tray"
allow_interference _ a=cCam b=cPod kind=weld reason="camera bracket"
allow_interference _ a=cDome b=cPod kind=weld reason="dome bonded on the nose ring"

# --- drawing: general arrangement (A2, first-angle) -------------------------------------
create_sheet ga name="HALO v2 GA" paper=A2 title="HALO v2 - general arrangement" drawnBy="llull" partNumber="HALO-GA-001" revision="A" date="2026-10-21" views=["front","top","iso"]
add_section_view _ sheetId=ga direction=front offset=0

# --- checks ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
check check_assembly thickness=off path=status expect == "pass"
check check_assembly clearanceMm=0.35 thickness=off path=status expect == "pass"   # tightest gaps: 0.4 mm between cells, 0.5 mm motor air gap
check max of=rotorUpper path=0 expect <= throatR-tipGap+0.5        # tip clearance to the duct throat
check max of=rotorLower path=0 expect <= throatR-tipGap+0.5
check min of=rotorUpper path=2 expect >= 110                         # rotor stack: upper loops stay above ...
check max of=rotorLower path=2 expect <= 100                         # ... the lower loops (>= 10 mm axial gap)
check min of=rotorLower path=2 expect >= strutTop+5                  # lower loops clear the vane struts
check bill_of_materials path=totalMassKg expect ~= 1.096 ± 3%
check bill_of_materials path=distinctComponents expect == 15
check bill_of_materials path=totalInstances expect == 35
check max of=cRing path=2 expect ~= ringTe+ringChord ± 0.1
check issues expect == 0
